captions.detailed: A short-travel dropper seatpost designed for compact bicycle frames. It features a matte black outer tube with a red lever-latch collar ring at the top, which pivots on a revolute joint to lock the height. A silver-metallic inner telescoping post slides vertically via a prismatic joint. At the crown of this inner post is a black pivoting saddle rail clamp head that tilts on a revolute joint, holding a narrow black racing saddle supported by two curved silver steel rails.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a short-travel bicycle dropper seatpost with a telescoping inner post, a red locking lever collar, and a pivoting saddle rail clamp holding a racing saddle, ensuring proper revolute and prismatic joints for height adjustment and saddle tilt.
captions.factory: Construct the outer tube using a black cylinder, adding a collar ring and a red box-based latch lever with a revolute joint. Model the inner telescoping post as a silver cylinder with height-indicator grooves, and attach it to the outer tube via a prismatic joint. Create the pivoting saddle clamp head on the inner post's crown using a revolute tilt joint. Build the saddle assembly with two curved sweep-profile steel rails and a thin, contoured racing shell, and attach it as a child of the clamp head.
